buildCommand: node scripts/db-setup.js --migrate-only && (if [ "$ENABLE_HARNESS" = "1" ]; then echo "[harness] ENABLE_HARNESS=1 — running gen+score"; npx tsx scripts/test-harness/cli.ts --mode=full && npx tsx scripts/test-harness/rubric/scorer.ts || echo "[harness] WARNING: gen or scorer failed (non-blocking)"; else echo "[harness] ENABLE_HARNESS not set — skipping gen"; fi) && next build
